g.text: Actual captured Node execution — offline unit run, not a live backend
Chioma issue #42 | focused offline source execution
Mocks: API, session store, Nest decorators, test clock and timer. No live network.
PASS default opt-out makes no API calls; invalid preferences rejected
PASS six-hour scheduler delivers rent, draft and dispute notices; lifecycle clears it
PASS same client session ID stays owner-scoped; opt-out affects only its owner
PASS opt-out during pending fetch suppresses delivery; overlapping poll is skipped
PASS expired opt-in and out-of-window notices do not deliver
PASS failed append retries once successfully, then deduplicates
PASS session reset cancels pending notification before awaiting store deletion
PASS existing preference tool filters categories and cancels a pending fetch on opt-out
PASS failed preference save cannot enable nudges; saved overnight quiet hours are respected
Not a full Nest build, HTTP integration run, or sponsor acceptance decision.
